source_locators: EGNO calls (8.30) a natural transformation, printed page 214
formal_proof_route: Braiding swaps the chosen exact pairing, making X a right dual of X*.
Uniqueness of right duals gives the objectwise inverse.
Braiding naturality plus evaluation and coevaluation mate identities prove naturality.
NatIso.ofComponents derives inverse naturality from objectwise isomorphisms.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.9.3 and equation (8.31), printed pages 214-215
formal_proof_route: The composite mopFunctor followed by unmopFunctor has positive double braiding as its tensorator.
Mathlib monoidal composition supplies the tensorator coherence laws.
Transport across the Drinfeld natural isomorphism constructs a coherent monoidal structure on the right double-dual functor.
This roadmap adopts EGNO equation (8.31) as the characterization of the standard double-dual tensorator.
The transported tensorator makes the Drinfeld monoidal defect exactly positive monodromy.
The balancing law cancels that monodromy and proves theta_X followed by u_X is monoidal.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.10.12 and equation (8.41), printed page 220
formal_proof_route: Dual uniqueness proves that the Drinfeld comparison preserves evaluation and coevaluation.
The canonical pivotal dimension reduces to the explicit ribbon loop in equation (8.41).
Braiding naturality cancels the inverse crossing from the swapped coevaluation against the positive crossing in the dual loop.
The evaluation mate law moves theta_(X*) across the cap.
The ribbon dual law identifies its mate with theta_(X**), and twist naturality moves that twist through the Drinfeld comparison.
The resulting ribbon loop for X* equals the ribbon loop for X, proving dim(X)=dim(X*).
steps.scope_note: The Lean proof establishes the ribbon-to-spherical direction directly for braided right-rigid categories. It does not use semisimplicity or prove the converse direction.

formal_proof_route: Expand the pivotal trace as coevaluation, the coupon composite followed by the pivotal map, and evaluation.
Move the first coupon across the coevaluation; the mate identity turns it into its right dual.
Move that right dual across the evaluation; the second mate identity turns it into the right double dual.
Naturality of the pivotal isomorphism rewrites a_X followed by f** as f followed by a_Y.
The remaining composite is exactly the trace cut after the other coupon.
steps.scope_note: Cyclicity is proved for every pivotal right-rigid monoidal category. Sphericality and semisimplicity are not used. EGNO Theorem 4.7.15 concerns equality of left and right traces and is not claimed here.

formal_proof_route: The interface stores a finite duplicate-free complete skeleton of simple representatives.
Every object comes with an actual finite biproduct isomorphism to listed simple summands; numerical multiplicities alone are not accepted.
Finite-dimensional Hom spaces record local finiteness, while the explicit decomposition records finite semisimplicity.
The tensor unit is stored as a listed simple representative, a strengthened finite-semisimple presentation of EGNO's End(1)=K condition.
Schur's lemma over the pinned algebraically closed field derives the canonical scalar equivalence K ≃ End(1).
Closed-diagram scalarization and its identity, additive, scalar, and composition laws are derived from that equivalence and cannot be caller-overridden.
Every object, and in particular every tensor product of simples, receives a proved finite identity resolution.
Binding a RibbonStructure to the fusion data derives the previously established pivotal, spherical, trace, and quantum-dimension interfaces.
steps.scope_note: This is a generic proof-relevant fusion-category interface. It does not instantiate a concrete category. Step 7 separately derives nondegeneracy and binds transport compatibility to two explicit global standard theorem inputs.

formal_proof_route: The explicit finite simple decomposition proves that composition through every simple object separates morphisms on both sides.
Finite-dimensionality upgrades the two separating composition maps to a perfect pairing.
Frobenius reciprocity bends arbitrary Hom spaces into cup and cap spaces through the simple tensor unit.
The cup-cap composite is proved equal to the pivotal trace, so nondegeneracy of the trace pairing is derived rather than stored.
The pivotal structure constructs the reverse exact pairings and both concrete mate linear equivalences with one coherent dual convention.
One all-objects SphericalMateTraceLaw produces every local mate PairingTransport; no basis-specific or diagram-specific equality is accepted.
The source and target tensorators are proved to cancel in a composite monoidal image coupon.
One all-endomorphisms PivotalFunctorTraceLaw produces every local functor pairing compatibility from the derived source and target perfect pairings.
steps.scope_note: Perfectness and all local transport constructors are kernel-checked. The two named global trace laws remain explicit theorem parameters because Mathlib v4.29.1 has no pivotal-functor or spherical graphical-calculus theorem from which to construct them automatically.

formal_proof_route: The input is an actual natural isomorphism of the identity functor together with its monoidality proof; no simple-object scalar table is accepted.
Schur's lemma derives the unique scalar action on every listed simple object.
Invertibility of the natural isomorphism proves every derived scalar is nonzero and therefore defines an element of K-units with integral powers.
The ribbon fusion structure supplies the quantum dimension of every simple.
The ordinary coefficient is forced to be dim(s), while the twisted coefficient is forced to be dim(s) times chi_s to the integral exponent.
The Kirby colour is represented as a formal finite weighted family, not as a nonexistent categorical object with arbitrary scalar multiplicities.
Diagram expansion and evaluation are proved to be exactly the corresponding finite weighted sum.
Exponent zero and the identity tensor automorphism both reduce definitionally or theoremically to the ordinary colour.
steps.scope_note: This step is generic in a ribbon fusion category and a monoidal natural automorphism of its identity functor. It derives the formal colour expansion but does not construct a nontrivial automorphism for any concrete category and does not yet prove a Kirby move.

formal_proof_route: The all-objects spherical insertion law selects finite trace-dual resolutions from the actual complete simple skeleton.
Cyclicity reverses each trace-dual basis, the pivotal mate equivalence transports it, and cyclicity reverses it again for inverse insertion.
Generalized sliding is constructed separately for every actual simple label; the formal Kirby colour is never used as one category object.
Each fixed-label graphical movie is proved first, then Lean lifts the equality termwise to any unchanged finite coefficient family.
The ordinary slide is accepted only with endpoints proved to evaluate the exact quantum-dimension-weighted formal colour.
The modular transparent-simple dimension is defined as an actual finite sum and proved equal to one from the simple-centre condition and the unit-dimension theorem input.
Both ambient dimensions are the same derived sum of squared ribbon quantum dimensions; callers supply only the two visible standard scalar certificates.
Cutting, killing, and isolated-unknot equations derive the 1--2 and 2--3 factors used by the existing normalization algebra.
Framed kinks and cut independence use the same ribbon-derived pivotal and right-dual convention as the trace-pairing layer.
Category, coherence, ordinary-slide, and generalized-movie identities are all content-hash shaped before package export.

steps.scope_note: Step 9 establishes the generic category-side Kirby algebra for the modular identity-functor route. All finite-sum, pairing-transport, dimension, and normalization consequences are kernel-checked. The named global graphical theorems remain explicit, source-located inputs. No whole-presentation evaluator, move-completeness theorem, marked-pair transport, or concrete category instance is claimed here.

explicit_non_claims: No independent braiding-free construction of the duality-induced double-dual tensorator has been compared with the equation-(8.31)-characterized tensorator.
The converse implication from sphericality of a canonical pivotal structure to the ribbon dual law has not been formalized because the downstream construction only needs ribbon-to-spherical.

EGNO Theorem 4.7.15, equality of left and right traces in a spherical tensor category, has not been formalized; Step 7 uses the explicitly source-bound Bärenz--Barrett mate trace law instead of silently deriving it.
The spherical mate trace law from Bärenz--Barrett Lemma 3.3 remains an explicit all-objects theorem input; it has not been rederived solely from the SphericalStructure fields in Lean.
Pivotal-functor trace preservation from Bärenz--Barrett Lemma 2.23 remains an explicit all-endomorphisms theorem input; a native pivotal-functor structure has not been formalized in Mathlib.

The source-backed global insertion, ordinary-slide, generalized graphical-movie, cancellation, and framed-kink laws remain explicit theorem parameters; Step 9 does not claim to have reconstructed the full graphical calculus from Mathlib primitives alone.
Step 9 is restricted to the modular identity-functor normalization profile; it does not establish the general premodular functor case.
No whole-presentation evaluator or four-manifold presentation-independence theorem is established by Step 9 alone.
No nontrivial tensor identity automorphism has been constructed for a concrete ribbon fusion category.
No concrete category has been instantiated.
